description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE (Terminator Storm Force, 2 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). The Ork player clicks the Boyz in the fight list and assigns every attack at the Terminator Squad (real clicks); enemy_targets_unit_fight opens for the Space Marines player; a real click on 'Use on Terminator Squad' spends 2 CP; attacks that target the Terminators have -1 D (EffectPrimitives.get_effect_minus_damage) until the Boyz have attacked — gone once their fight resolved.
